dialogs.about: 거실에서 손녀와 목도리를 뜨고 종이접기를 함

lines.en: Grandma, what are you making?
I am knitting a warm scarf for you.
lines.ko: 너에게 줄 따뜻한 목도리를 뜨고 있어요.

lines.en: Wow! Is that soft yarn?
Yes. I bought it last week at the market.
Can you show me how to knit too?
Of course. Hold the yarn in your left hand.
This is hard. Let's do origami instead!
Okay. Please bring the paper and red ribbon.
I need tape for this paper bird.
Here. Tomorrow we will make more crafts together.
Excuse me. Do you sell needles and thread?
Yes, ma'am. They are on that small shelf.
lines.ko: 네, 손님. 저 작은 선반에 있어요.

lines.en: I want to sew a button on this.
This thread is strong. Try this needle too.
lines.ko: 이 실이 튼튼해요. 이 바늘도 써 보세요.

lines.en: Do you have soft yarn for a scarf?
Yes. This yarn came in yesterday morning.
lines.ko: 네. 이 털실은 어제 아침에 들어왔어요.

lines.en: Wonderful. I will knit a scarf tonight.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 오늘 밤에 목도리를 뜰 거예요.

lines.en: Do you also need ribbon or tape?
One ribbon, please. My craft class is tomorrow.
lines.ko: 리본 하나 주세요. 내일 공예 수업이 있어요.

lines.en: Thank you. Enjoy your class, ma'am!
